title: Alibaba's Wan3.0 generates AI videos up to 30 seconds long from text, images, and documents
summary: Alibaba's video generation model Wan3.0 creates clips up to 30 seconds long from text, PDFs, and PowerPoint files. A 30-second 1080p clip costs $6. Alibaba's quarterly profit dropped 75 percent year-over-year as the company ramps up AI spending.
